title: CBOR scanner: u64-to-usize truncation on 32-bit platforms
description: In presence.rs scan_cbor_item() line 119, 'length as usize' truncates u64 values on 32-bit systems. A CBOR string claiming length 0x1_0000_0010 would truncate to 0x10, passing the bounds check. Practical impact is low (4KB payload limit, ciborium fails anyway, rare 32-bit target), but this is a defense-in-depth failure. Fix: check length > usize::MAX as u64 before cast, or use saturating conversion.
